the CPT-Cm complex was purified, crystallized and the crystals diffract.

we have obtained a crystal structure of a novel chloramphemicol-inactivating enzyme, chloramphemicl 3-O-phospatransferase from S. venezuelae ISP 5230, which is the first crystal structure of a chloramphemicoll-inactivating enzyme.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of acetonitrile to the crystallization drops of a CPT-Cm complex resulted in a significant improvement of the diffraction quality of the crystals.
the addition of the substrate to the crystallization drops can significantly improve the diffraction quality of CPT crystals.

the addition of a small amount of acetonitrile in the crystallization drops of a protein complex is a simple and efficient way to improve the diffraction of the crystals and to obtain better quality crystals.
